events.title: Julius Caesar dedicates the Temple of Venus Genetrix
events.description: Amid the celebrations of his triumphs, Caesar dedicated a temple to Venus Genetrix, the mythical ancestress of his family, in his new forum. It proclaimed his divine lineage and unrivalled power.
events.html: Amid the celebrations of his triumphs, Caesar dedicated a temple to Venus Genetrix, the mythical ancestress of his family, in his new forum. It proclaimed his divine lineage and unrivalled power.

events.title: William II of England is crowned king
events.description: William II, called Rufus, the third son of William the Conqueror, was crowned king of England. He put down rebellions by barons who favoured his elder brother Robert Curthose, and in 1096 took Normandy in pledge from Robert.
events.html: William II, called Rufus, the third son of William the Conqueror, was crowned king of England. He put down rebellions by barons who favoured his elder brother Robert Curthose, and in 1096 took Normandy in pledge from Robert.

events.title: The Ottomans destroy a Serbian army at the Battle of Maritsa
events.description: At Chernomen on the Maritsa river, an Ottoman force under Lala Şahin Pasha destroyed the army of the Serbian king Vukašin and the despot Jovan Uglješa, both of whom were killed. The defeat opened Macedonia to the Ottomans.

events.title: A French army defeats the English at La Brossinière
events.description: In the Hundred Years' War, a French army defeated English forces at La Brossinière, in a battle also known as the Battle of la Gravelle.
events.html: In the Hundred Years' War, a French army defeated English forces at La Brossinière, in a battle also known as the Battle of la Gravelle.

events.title: Francis Drake returns from his voyage around the world
events.description: The Golden Hind sailed into Plymouth after nearly three years, laden with Spanish treasure. Drake was the first captain to complete a circumnavigation and was knighted aboard his ship the next April.
events.html: The Golden Hind sailed into Plymouth after nearly three years, laden with Spanish treasure. Drake was the first captain to complete a circumnavigation and was knighted aboard his ship the next April.

events.title: A Venetian shell blows apart the Parthenon
events.description: During the Venetian siege of the Acropolis, a mortar shell ignited Ottoman gunpowder stored in the Parthenon. The explosion destroyed the temple's centre and killed some 300 people.
events.html: During the Venetian siege of the Acropolis, a mortar shell ignited Ottoman gunpowder stored in the Parthenon. The explosion destroyed the temple's centre and killed some 300 people.

events.title: Einstein's paper on special relativity is published
events.description: Annalen der Physik published Einstein's 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies', which showed that measurements of time and space depend on the observer's motion. It transformed physics.
events.html: Annalen der Physik published Einstein's 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies', which showed that measurements of time and space depend on the observer's motion. It transformed physics.

events.title: Stanislav Petrov judges a Soviet missile alert a false alarm
events.description: Duty officer Stanislav Petrov saw satellite warnings of US missile launches and reported them as a malfunction rather than an attack. He was right, and may have averted a nuclear war.
